annotations.text:
Two Avatars, One Line
Makes the couple metaphor literal with a connection diagram. Boldest and most memorable — costs more vertical space.

Refined Default
Closest to today's Settings rows, just with real SVG icons and chevrons instead of emoji. Safest to ship, least distinctive.

Code-First / Ticket Stub
Treats the invite code like a real paper stub. Most restrained and typographic — icon-light, leans on layout to carry the feeling.
